tier_should.rationale: Large, harmonized multi-country RCTs on remote education in emergencies; credible design and scalable interventions; strong policy relevance. Some novelty reduced by parallel COVID tutoring literature. Fit is excellent for top field journals in development/education.

tier_will.rationale: High-powered evidence with prominent authors and policy partners; clean trials across five countries. Competitive for AEJ Applied/JDE/JPubE; less likely for top-five given crowded COVID schooling literature and limited mechanism depth.
